hardware_arming_tests: runtime latch falling clears all modules and requires explicit rearm
role_test: Absent host role refuses arming; removing role stops all modules; restoring role does not revive pulses
i2c_tests: bus-error abort and deadline across rollover
board_contract: GPIO2 JP_LOCAL_MASTER_N LOW=host/HIGH=expander; GPIO18 RAW_SAFE_PERMIT HIGH=healthy/LOW=fault; GPIO21 HW_RUN HIGH=latch armed. GPIO15 MCU_OE_N HIGH=disable, only explicit arm creates falling edge after all output bytes zeroed, then HW_RUN must acknowledge within 1 ms polling allowance. Two 165s per module capture UVFAULT high byte then CONTACTS_N low byte, each bit0=input1; closed=(~CONTACTS_N)&(~UVFAULT). Inputs host first; 595 bytes downstream first/host last.
